request.text: There's a red container on the south wall, behind the nano-fab yard. The family left with a Kah-rah-veen caravan and made the bunk before they went. That's how you know they won't be back. Forty credits, and I write your name on the roll. In Ward that's worth more than the key. It means somebody counts you.
